column1: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water, adding the broccoli for the last 3–4 minutes. Reserve a mug of pasta water, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.
Add a splash of pasta water and stir. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in the truffle cheddar until melted.
Add the pasta and broccoli and toss gently, adding pasta water a little at a time until the sauce is silky.
Finish with plenty of black pepper.
